say:1:1221301002:0.text: T—The glimmerbloom is actually calling for Hammie!
say:1:1221301002:0.source_cn: 这、这只荧荧花居然在叫漫漫！

say:4:1221302002:1.text: If I'm not mistaken, it was shouting Hammie's name... Could it be here to meet Hammie?
say:4:1221302002:1.source_cn: 而且它喊的好像是漫漫的名字……难道它是特意来找漫漫的？

say:5:1221302003:1.text:
Huh?!
What business do I have with the glimmerbloom?
say:5:1221302003:1.source_cn: 哎？！\n可是荧荧花为什么要找我……？

say:6:1221302004:1.text: Hammie! The camp ahead! Good stuff!

say:7:1221302005:1.text: Hmm... Are you trying to say there's a camp up ahead, and it has something we need?
say:7:1221302005:1.source_cn: 唔……你是想说，前面有座营地，营地里有我们需要的东西？

say:8:1221302006:1.text: Yes! Yes! Hammie likes it! Hammie needs it!
say:8:1221302006:1.source_cn: 没错、没错！漫漫喜欢、漫漫想要的，东西！

say:9:1221302007:1.text: Wait, don't go! You haven't told me what's the thing!
say:9:1221302007:1.source_cn: 等等，你别跑啊！你还没说是什么呢——！

say:10:1221302008:1.text: How weird. I wonder how the glimmerbloom knows what I want...
say:10:1221302008:1.source_cn: 这只荧荧花好奇怪，它怎么会知道我想要什么东西呢……

choice_prompt:11:1221302008.text: How weird. I wonder how the glimmerbloom knows what I want...
choice_prompt:11:1221302008.source_cn: 这只荧荧花好奇怪，它怎么会知道我想要什么东西呢……

say:12:1221302009:1.text:
Chippy will take a guess!
A new staff? A taller, prettier hat? Magister's magical notes? Or a familiar medal awarded by Magister?
say:12:1221302009:1.source_cn: 让满满来猜猜！\n一根新法杖？一顶更高更漂亮的帽子？主...
say:12:1221302009:1.male:
Chippy will take a guess!
A new staff? A taller, prettier hat? Magister's magical notes? Or a familiar medal awarded by Magister?
say:12:1221302009:1.female:
Chippy will take a guess!
A new staff? A taller, prettier hat? Magister's magical notes? Or a familiar medal awarded by Magister?

choice_prompt:13:1221302009.text:
Chippy will take a guess!
A new staff? A taller, prettier hat? Magister's magical notes? Or a familiar medal awarded by Magister?
choice_prompt:13:1221302009.source_cn: 让满满来猜猜！\n一根新法杖？一顶更高更漂亮的帽子？主人的魔法笔记？还是主人颁发的使魔奖章？
choice_prompt:13:1221302009.male:
Chippy will take a guess!
A new staff? A taller, prettier hat? Magister's magical notes? Or a familiar medal awarded by Magister?
choice_prompt:13:1221302009.female:
Chippy will take a guess!
A new staff? A taller, prettier hat? Magister's magical notes? Or a familiar medal awarded by Magister?

say:14:1221302010:1.text: Magister, don't you know that Hammie's collected many of your belongings?
say:14:1221302010:1.source_cn: 主人不知道吗？漫漫收集了好多“梅林周边”——
say:14:1221302010:1.male: Magister, don't you know that Hammie's collected many of your belongings?
say:14:1221302010:1.female: Magister, don't you know that Hammie's collected many of your belongings?

say:16:1221302013:1.text: I can't think of anything else... There are simply too many things that Hammie desires, after all.
say:16:1221302013:1.source_cn: 那我就猜不出来了……毕竟漫漫想要的东西太多了。

say:17:1221302014:1.text: Whatever it is, it'd be crazy to think that I'd find it on this deserted island!
say:17:1221302014:1.source_cn: 无论我想要的是什么，出现在这种荒无人烟的海岛上都不合理吧！

say:18:1221302015:1.text: The glimmerbloom mentioned a camp just now, right? Maybe it was built by some previous inhabitants.
say:18:1221302015:1.source_cn: 荧荧花不是说那里是个营地？也许是以前登岛的人留下来的。
say:18:1221302015:1.male: The glimmerbloom mentioned a camp just now, right? Maybe it was built by some previous inhabitants.
say:18:1221302015:1.female: The glimmerbloom mentioned a camp just now, right? Maybe it was built by some previous inhabitants.

say:19:1221302016:1.text: Anyway, let's check out the place first. We might actually find something nice!
say:19:1221302016:1.source_cn: 总之我们先去看看吧，说不定真的能找到什么好东西呢！
say:19:1221302016:1.male: Anyway, let's check out the place first. We might actually find something nice!
say:19:1221302016:1.female: Anyway, let's check out the place first. We might actually find something nice!

say:22:1221302011:1.text: Yup, and Hammie's wheedled one out of you before!
say:22:1221302011:1.source_cn: 是啊，还是漫漫缠着主人发的呢！
say:22:1221302011:1.male: Yup, and Hammie's wheedled one out of you before!
say:22:1221302011:1.female: Yup, and Hammie's wheedled one out of you before!

choice:11:0:1.text: So, what's it that you want?
choice:11:0:1.male: So, what's it that you want?
choice:11:0:1.female: So, what's it that you want?

say:0:1221303001:0.text: I can't wait to find out what the glimmerbloom has found for Hammie!
say:0:1221303001:0.source_cn: 荧荧花帮漫漫找到的东西到底是什么，好好奇啊！

say:1:1221303002:0.text: I don't even have the slightest clue myself...
say:1:1221303002:0.source_cn: 别说是你了，连我自己也不清楚……

say:0:1221304001:0.text: This should be the camp, but I don't see anything special... Let's ask the glimmerbloom directly.
say:0:1221304001:0.source_cn: 荧荧花说的应该就是这个营地了，可是我什么也没看到……还...

say:4:1221305002:1.text: It's inside the chest! My gut feeling tells me it's something valuable!
say:4:1221305002:1.source_cn: 居然在箱子里！满满感觉会是很珍贵的东西！

say:5:1221305003:1.text: Glimmerbloom, can you tell us what's inside?
say:5:1221305003:1.source_cn: 荧荧花，你能告诉我们箱子里是什么东西吗？

say:6:1221305004:1.source_cn: 是，笔记！很多很多的，笔记！

say:7:1221305005:1.text: Notes... Could they be some lost magical notes?!
say:7:1221305005:1.source_cn: 笔记……难道是失传的魔法笔记？！

say:8:1221305006:1.text: What are we waiting for? Let's start digging!
say:8:1221305006:1.source_cn: 那还等什么？赶快找找看吧！

say:2:1221306001:1.text: The notes are all here! Hammie, see what's written on them!
say:2:1221306001:1.source_cn: 箱子里的笔记全都找出来啦！漫漫，你快看看上面写的都是什么吧！

say:5:1221306003:1.text: The handwriting on these notes... is mine!
say:5:1221306003:1.source_cn: 这些笔记……全部都是我的字迹！
say:5:1221306003:1.male: The handwriting on these notes... is mine!
say:5:1221306003:1.female: The handwriting on these notes... is mine!

say:6:1221306005:1.text: Huh?! How did your notes end up here?!
say:6:1221306005:1.source_cn: 哎？！你的笔记怎么会出现在这里？！

say:7:1221306006:1.text: I have no idea! I always keep my notes properly, and I don't remember losing them.
say:7:1221306006:1.source_cn: 我也不知道呀！我平时的笔记都会好好收起来，也不记得有丢失过。

say:8:1221306007:1.text: But I did jot down those things on the notes...
say:8:1221306007:1.source_cn: 可是这些笔记上的内容，也的确是我亲手写的……

say:9:1221306008:1.text: ...This is way too bizarre! Can you find anything off about these notes?
say:9:1221306008:1.source_cn: ……太古怪了！这些笔记上就没有什么可疑的地方吗？

say:10:1221306009:1.text: Hmm, let me take a closer look...

say:13:1221306012:1.text:
T—The last page...
It's the recipe for an elixir that can restore memory!
say:13:1221306012:1.source_cn: 最、最后一页……\n居然是能让人恢复记忆的魔法药水配方！

say:14:1221306013:1.text: What?! Such an elixir actually exists?! Why didn't you tell us sooner?
say:14:1221306013:1.source_cn: 什么？！有这种药水！漫漫你为什么不早点拿出来？

say:15:1221306014:1.text: I wasn't the one who found it!
say:15:1221306014:1.source_cn: 这个配方……不是我找到的！

say:16:1221306015:1.text: Indeed, I've been working on ways to help the Magister recover his memory, but I never succeeded—I'm very certain of that.
say:16:1221306015:1.source_cn: 虽然我一直在寻找帮助梅林恢复记忆的办法，但从来都没有找...
say:16:1221306015:1.male: Indeed, I've been working on ways to help the Magister recover his memory, but I never succeeded—I'm very certain of that.
say:16:1221306015:1.female: Indeed, I've been working on ways to help the Magister recover her memory, but I never succeeded—I'm very certain of that.

say:17:1221306016:1.text: If I'd found a solution, I'd have told all of you long go. Why would I wait until now?
say:17:1221306016:1.source_cn: 要不然的话，我肯定早就拿出来了，干嘛要等到现在？

choice_prompt:18:1221306016.text: If I'd found a solution, I'd have told all of you long go. Why would I wait until now?
choice_prompt:18:1221306016.source_cn: 要不然的话，我肯定早就拿出来了，干嘛要等到现在？

say:19:1221306017:1.text: Are you saying the glimmerbloom found this recipe because Hammie wants to help you recover your memory?
say:19:1221306017:1.source_cn: 主人的意思是，因为漫漫想要帮主人恢复记忆，所以荧荧花特...
say:19:1221306017:1.male: Are you saying the glimmerbloom found this recipe because Hammie wants to help you recover your memory?
say:19:1221306017:1.female: Are you saying the glimmerbloom found this recipe because Hammie wants to help you recover your memory?

say:20:1221306018:1.text: I—I just can't wrap my head around this! Why would the glimmerbloom know I need the recipe? Also, why is the recipe in my handwriting...
say:20:1221306018:1.source_cn: 这、这实在太奇怪了！荧荧花怎么会知道我想要记忆药水？而...

say:21:1221306019:1.text: The recipe seems viable anyway. Maybe it could really work!
say:21:1221306019:1.source_cn: 不过，配方的原理看起来没有问题，或许真的有用^

say:22:1221306020:1.text: Magister, do you want to give it a try?
say:22:1221306020:1.male: Magister, do you want to give it a try?
say:22:1221306020:1.female: Magister, do you want to give it a try?

choice_prompt:23:1221306020.text: Magister, do you want to give it a try?
choice_prompt:23:1221306020.male: Magister, do you want to give it a try?
choice_prompt:23:1221306020.female: Magister, do you want to give it a try?

say:24:1221306023:1.text: Say no more, let's whip up the elixir! Hammie, what ingredients do we need?
say:24:1221306023:1.source_cn: 别说那么多了，我们赶快准备药水吧！漫漫，配方上都需要什...

say:25:1221306024:1.text: Well, the recipe isn't too complicated. We just need some <style="highlight">unripe fruit of tune sprouts</style> and <style="highlight">raccoon tail grass grown in the shade</style>.
say:25:1221306024:1.source_cn: 嗯……原材料倒是很简单，只需要<style=highl...

say:26:1221306025:1.text: There should be some nearby. Let's get our hands dirty!
say:26:1221306025:1.source_cn: 附近应该就有这两种植物，我们去找找看吧~

choice:23:0:1.text: We have to try it, of course.
choice:23:0:1.male: We have to try it, of course.
choice:23:0:1.female: We have to try it, of course.

say:28:1221306021:1.text: We can! But it'd be better if you could remember those forgotten spells and the times we spent together.
say:28:1221306021:1.source_cn: 现在当然也很好！但如果能找回丢失的记忆，你肯定能回忆起...
say:28:1221306021:1.male: We can! But it'd be better if you could remember those forgotten spells and the times we spent together.
say:28:1221306021:1.female: We can! But it'd be better if you could remember those forgotten spells and the times we spent together.

say:29:1221306022:1.text: Those experiences, while being somewhat mundane, mean a lot to us!
say:29:1221306022:1.source_cn: 那些经历虽然有些平淡，却也是最宝贵的！
say:29:1221306022:1.male: Those experiences, while being somewhat mundane, mean a lot to us!
say:29:1221306022:1.female: Those experiences, while being somewhat mundane, mean a lot to us!

choice:23:1:2.text: Can't we just leave things as they are?
choice:23:1:2.male: Can't we just leave things as they are?
choice:23:1:2.female: Can't we just leave things as they are?

choice:18:0:1.text: These notes must be what the glimmerbloom was referring to.
choice:18:0:1.source_cn: 这应该就是荧荧花说的东西
choice:18:0:1.male: These notes must be what the glimmerbloom was referring to.
choice:18:0:1.female: These notes must be what the glimmerbloom was referring to.

say:30:1221306004:1.text: No... But these notes actually belong to me!
say:30:1221306004:1.source_cn: 不是……但这些，全都是我的笔记……！
say:30:1221306004:1.male: No... But these notes actually belong to me!
say:30:1221306004:1.female: No... But these notes actually belong to me!

choice:4:1:2.text: Could they be about some forbidden magic?
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 该不会是禁忌魔法笔记吧
choice:4:1:2.male: Could they be about some forbidden magic?
choice:4:1:2.female: Could they be about some forbidden magic?

say:0:1221307001:0.text: Chippy can smell it! The scent of tune sprouts and raccoon tail grass is in this area!
say:0:1221307001:0.source_cn: 满满闻到了，周围有琴豆木和狸尾草的味道！

say:0:1221308001:0.text: It's said that tune sprouts fruit has memory-enhancing properties. I think we have enough for now.
say:0:1221308001:0.source_cn: 据说琴豆木的果实能增强人的记忆力，现在这些应该足够了。

say:0:1221309001:0.text: According to the recipe, foxtail grass has an odd taste. It's best we don't put too much.
say:0:1221309001:0.source_cn: 配方上说，狸尾草吃起来有种奇怪的味道，还是少放一点比较好。

say:0:1221310001:0.text: Now that we've got everything we need, let's go back to the camp to make the elixir.
say:0:1221310001:0.source_cn: 材料都找齐了，我们回刚才的营地制作记忆药水吧。

say:1:1221310002:0.text: I remember there's a cauldron over there.
say:1:1221310002:0.source_cn: 我记得，那里有一口大锅。

say:2:1221311001:1.text:
This one?
Hammie, do you want to make the elixir?
say:2:1221311001:1.source_cn: 就是这口锅了吧！\n漫漫，你来制作药水吗？

say:3:1221311002:1.text: I'd love to, but the elixir is for the Magister... I—I'm afraid I might mess up.
say:3:1221311002:1.source_cn: 我是很想自己来，可是一想到这瓶药水要给梅林喝……我、我...
say:3:1221311002:1.male: I'd love to, but the elixir is for the Magister... I—I'm afraid I might mess up.
say:3:1221311002:1.female: I'd love to, but the elixir is for the Magister... I—I'm afraid I might mess up.

say:4:1221311003:1.text: That's true. We just aren't cut out for this kind of task with our tiny hands!
say:4:1221311003:1.source_cn: 唔，也是，我们这种小短手确实很不方便！

say:6:1221311005:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you mind preparing the elixir yourself?
say:6:1221311005:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you mind preparing the elixir yourself?
say:6:1221311005:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you mind preparing the elixir yourself?

choice_prompt:7:1221311005.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you mind preparing the elixir yourself?
choice_prompt:7:1221311005.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you mind preparing the elixir yourself?
choice_prompt:7:1221311005.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, do you mind preparing the elixir yourself?

say:8:1221311006:1.text: Great! With Magister in charge, I'm sure the elixir will turn out fine!
say:8:1221311006:1.source_cn: 那太好了！主人亲自出马，药水肯定不会出问题的！
say:8:1221311006:1.male: Great! With Magister in charge, I'm sure the elixir will turn out fine!
say:8:1221311006:1.female: Great! With Magister in charge, I'm sure the elixir will turn out fine!

document:9:49:0.text:
Ingredients:
<style="highlight">Foxtail grass</style> grown in the shade and unripe fruit of <style="highlight">tune sprouts</style>.

Put the materials in a pot, add water, and simmer over high heat until the liquid is entirely clear.

Reminder: Consume quickly! Otherwise, the potency of the medicine will decrease over time!
document:9:49:0.source_cn:
原材料：<style="highlight">长在阴影里的狸尾草</style>、<style="highlight">琴豆木的青涩果实</style>，制作方法：将原材料放进锅里，加水大火熬煮，直至液体完全清澈。
注意：尽快服用！否则药效会逐渐流失！

say:18:1221311011:1.text: So, this is the memory elixir... The shimmering liquid seems to hold a powerful magical force!
say:18:1221311011:1.source_cn: 这就是记忆药水……看起来亮晶晶的，像是蕴含着很神奇的魔力！

say:19:1221311012:1.text: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!
say:19:1221311012:1.source_cn: 主人，赶快喝下去试试吧，说不定马上就能恢复记忆了！
say:19:1221311012:1.male: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!
say:19:1221311012:1.female: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!

choice_prompt:20:1221311012.male: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!
choice_prompt:20:1221311012.female: Go ahead and drink it, Magister! You might remember everything right away!

say:21:1221311013:1.text: How does it taste? We went easy on the foxtail grass so it wouldn't taste too yucky.
say:21:1221311013:1.source_cn: 味道怎么样？狸尾草放得不多，但愿不会让它变得太难喝。
say:21:1221311013:1.male: How does it taste? We went easy on the foxtail grass so it wouldn't taste too yucky.
say:21:1221311013:1.female: How does it taste? We went easy on the foxtail grass so it wouldn't taste too yucky.

say:22:1221311014:1.text:
O-oh, no! Magister's about to pass out!
Magister!
say:22:1221311014:1.source_cn: 不……不好，主人好像站不稳了！\n主人——
say:22:1221311014:1.male:
O-oh, no! Magister's about to pass out!
Magister!
say:22:1221311014:1.female:

narration:23:1221311015:0.text: Maybe the elixir really works, or maybe it just tastes too awful. Either way, memories after you woke up at the Mystical House flash quickly before your eyes, and you even recall some long-forgotten details...
narration:23:1221311015:0.source_cn: 不知道是因为记忆药水的确有用，还是因为它太难喝，从神秘...

say:26:1221311017:0.text: Chippy's so relieved! You gave us such a fright just now!
say:26:1221311017:0.source_cn: 主人醒过来了就好！刚才真是吓坏我们了！
say:26:1221311017:0.male: Chippy's so relieved! You gave us such a fright just now!
say:26:1221311017:0.female: Chippy's so relieved! You gave us such a fright just now!

say:28:1221311018:1.text: How are you feeling, Magister? Do you remember anything from before?
say:28:1221311018:1.source_cn: 梅林，你感觉怎么样？有没有想起之前的事？
say:28:1221311018:1.male: How are you feeling, Magister? Do you remember anything from before?
say:28:1221311018:1.female: How are you feeling, Magister? Do you remember anything from before?
